text: Tenant agrees to automatic renewal of this lease for successive 12-month terms unless written notice is given at least 90 days prior to expiration.
Landlord may enter the premises at any time without prior notice for any reason.
Service provider's total liability under this agreement shall not exceed $50, regardless of the damages incurred.
Employee agrees not to compete with the company for a period of 5 years following termination within a 500-mile radius.
Tenant waives all rights to a security deposit refund regardless of the condition of the premises at move-out.
The company may terminate this agreement at any time for any reason without notice.
Tenant is responsible for all repairs and maintenance regardless of cause or fault.
Employee agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the employer from any claims arising from employment.
Landlord may increase rent at any time by any amount with 7 days notice.
Client waives all rights to a refund for services not rendered.
Tenant agrees to pay all legal fees incurred by landlord in any dispute regardless of outcome.
Employee assigns all inventions and creative works to the company, including those created on personal time.
This agreement may be amended at any time by the company without notice to the other party.
Tenant agrees that the landlord is not liable for any injuries on the premises regardless of negligence.
Employee agrees to work overtime without additional compensation as required by management.
Late fees of $50 per day shall accrue for any payment received after the due date.
Tenant may not sublet or assign this lease under any circumstances without landlord approval.
Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice.
Rent shall be paid on the 1st of each month.
Employee agrees not to disclose confidential company information during or after employment.
